sql: SELECT seniority, median(comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay, median(comp_mid_usd) - (SELECT median(comp_mid_usd) FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND is_canonical_listing) AS diff_from_overall FROM fct_posting WHERE is_open AND remote_us AND is_canonical_listing GROUP BY seniority
reason: The query calculates the median pay midpoint for each seniority level and subtracts the global median of the same filtered dataset to find the difference.
